newsitem.title: USA: ITT board meets, delays action on Hilton bid.
newsitem.headline: ITT board meets, delays action on Hilton bid.

text.p: ITT Corp. said a board of directors meeting ended Tuesday without the board taking action on a $6.5 billion unsolicited takeover bid from Hilton Hotels Corp.

The meeting, held in New York, was the first board session since Hilton launched its offer last week. The board, which has until Feb. 14 to respond to Hilton's offer, had not been expected to make a decision right away.
ITT said no date for another board meeting had been set.

On Saturday, ITT Chairman Rand Araskog turned down a request from Hilton Chief Executive Officer Stephen Bollenbach to meet before the board meeting or be permitted to make a presentation to the ITT board.
The cash and stock transaction values ITT at $55 a share.
ITT stock, which rose sharply last week on views that Hilton will be forced to raise its bid, fell 25 cents to $56.75 on the New York Stock Exchange.
